title: Route the packet before it escapes
description: Choose a production packet and an operating policy. Watch the same candidate move through intake, routing, extraction, evidence gates, and a downstream decision.

policies.label: Extension plus aggregate score
policies.detail: Use the file extension, a general extractor, and one document-level score. Fast, but blind to field and relationship failures.

policies.label: Classifier plus field confidence
policies.detail: Route low-classifier results to a specialist and gate critical fields, but do not require complete anchors or reconciliation.

policies.label: Action-specific evidence contract
policies.detail: Require page completeness, critical-field evidence, structural coverage, source anchors, and reconciliation before promotion.

packets.label: Native invoice with stable layout
packets.detail: A two-page digital invoice from a known supplier. The total, currency, and line items agree.
packets.specialistReason: The general invoice route covers this family.
packets.failureTruth: No labeled extraction failure in this replay packet.

packets.label: Noisy scan with a plausible wrong total
packets.detail: OCR reads a stamped digit incorrectly. The aggregate score looks healthy, but subtotal plus tax does not equal the extracted total.
packets.specialistReason: The family is known, but the candidate needs a stronger scan or review path.
packets.failureTruth: The total is wrong even though its local confidence is high.

packets.label: Mixed claims bundle
packets.detail: One upload combines a claim form, correspondence, and an attachment with an unseen layout.
packets.actionRisk: Create a claim and assign coverage
packets.specialistReason: The bundle must be split and its unseen document family classified before extraction.
packets.failureTruth: The general route joins fields from different document units.

packets.label: High-confidence packet with a missing page
packets.detail: The visible fields are clear, but page three of a four-page application was never uploaded.
packets.specialistReason: A parser cannot reconstruct evidence that was never uploaded.
packets.failureTruth: The absent page contains a required authorization section.
